function.name: get_current_timestamp
function.description: Get the current Unix timestamp in seconds.

function.name: ask_user
function.description:
Ask the user clarifying questions before continuing.
Use this when the next step depends on user intent, preference, or a tradeoff that cannot be inferred safely.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description:
1-3 question objects, each with id, header, question, and 2-3 options. Each option needs label and description.
List the option you recommend first; the UI labels the first option Recommended.

allow_other.title: Allow Other
allow_other.description: Whether users may enter a free-form answer instead of choosing one of the options

timeout_ms.title: Timeout Ms
timeout_ms.description: How long the browser should keep the prompt open before cancelling it

function.name: search_chats
function.description:
Search the user's previous chat conversations by title and message content,
excluding the current chat. Helpful for finding details from earlier
conversations when they are not already visible in the current context.
Exact phrase matches are preferred, and descriptive keyword queries are
supported.

query.title: Query
query.description: Exact phrase or descriptive keyword query to find matching previous chats

count.title: Count
count.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

start_timestamp.title: Start Timestamp
start_timestamp.description: Only include chats updated after this Unix timestamp (seconds)

end_timestamp.title: End Timestamp
end_timestamp.description: Only include chats updated before this Unix timestamp (seconds)

function.name: search_knowledge_files
function.description:
Search files by filename across knowledge bases the user has access to.
When the model has attached knowledge, searches only within attached KBs and files.
Helpful when looking for a specific document or file name.

query.title: Query
query.description: The search query to find matching files by filename

knowledge_id.title: Knowledge Id
knowledge_id.description: Optional KB id to limit search to a specific knowledge base

count.title: Count
count.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

skip.title: Skip
skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

turns.user: I want a backup plan for our servers. Ask me what you need to know before suggesting anything.

function.name: ask_user
function.arguments: {"questions":[{"id":"rpo","header":"Data loss","question":"How much data can you afford to lose?","options":[{"label":"An hour","description":"Hourly snapshots"},{"label":"A day","description":"Nightly backups"}]}]}

turns.user: Thanks. Say in one line what I picked.

replay_assistant.content: You can afford to lose up to a day of data, so nightly backups.
